Google, Meta, and TikTok are suing to stop the restrictions. Age checks could raise privacy concerns for adults, too. Google, Meta, and TikTok filed separate federal lawsuits on November 4, challenging Assembly Bill 1709 , which Governor Gavin Newsom signed in September. The companies argue that the law, due to take effect in 2027, interferes with free speech, overrides parents’ decisions, and conflicts with federal protections for online platforms.
